mapper.sql: id, anonymous_key, slow_walk_speed_mps, walk_speed_mps, fast_walk_speed_mps, run_speed_mps, sample_count, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO traveler_profile ( id, anonymous_key, slow_walk_speed_mps, walk_speed_mps, fast_walk_speed_mps, run_speed_mps, sample_count, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{anonymousKey}, #{slowWalkSpeedMps}, #{walkSpeedMps}, #{fastWalkSpeedMps}, #{runSpeedMps}, #{sampleCount}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ) ON CONFLICT (anonymous_key) DO UPDATE SET slow_walk_speed_mps = EXCLUDED.slow_walk_speed_mps, walk_speed_mps = EXCLUDED.walk_speed_mps, fast_walk_speed_mps = EXCLUDED.fast_walk_speed_mps, run_speed_mps = EXCLUDED.run_speed_mps, sample_count = EXCLUDED.sample_count, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM traveler_profile WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
